title: origins.json — per-platform registry of catalog origins (D-14)
description: Build-time INPUT consumed by tools/build_catalog.py (EPIC-10). Lists a platform's origins (creators' apps.json) for one release channel (D-19); one is official (SidecarTridge), the rest are creator URLs. Not loaded by the UI. Invariants (enforced by the batch, not expressible here): exactly one origin has official=true, and one registry per (platform, channel) pair.

channel.description: Release channel this registry feeds (D-19). Absent = stable. Output: stable -> <platform>/apps.json, otherwise <platform>/apps-<channel>.json.

official.description: Exactly one origin per platform is true (SidecarTridge).

source.description: In-repo path to this origin's apps.json (used by the official origin).

url.description: Remote URL (HTTP or HTTPS) to a creator's apps.json; fetched server-side at build time, so HTTP is allowed (HTTPS recommended). D-16.

id.description: Unique creator id (slug) within the platform; creator <-> origin is 1:1.
